## Overview

This presentation proposes a professional portfolio website that highlights my background, academic work, and career interests in business, marketing, analytics, and strategy.

### Proposal Goals

-   Build a clean and modern personal brand
-   Showcase academic and project-based experience
-   Highlight analytical, strategic, and communication skills
-   Create a site that can support internships, networking, and future job applications
-   Present my work in a format that is easy to explore and visually professional

::: notes
Open by explaining that this website is more than a class assignment. It is meant to function as a professional asset for internships, job applications, and networking.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Why I Need This Website

A portfolio website gives me a central place to present who I am, what I have worked on, and what I can contribute.

-   A resume is concise, but limited
-   A website gives space for projects, visuals, and storytelling
-   Employers can quickly understand my strengths and interests
-   It helps me stand out from other candidates with similar coursework
-   It gives my academic work a professional presentation format

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Website Purpose

### Main Purpose

The website will function as a digital portfolio that communicates my professional identity.

### What visitors should learn quickly

-   Who I am
-   What I study
-   What type of work interests me
-   What projects I have completed
-   What skills I can bring to a team
-   How to contact me

## Site Map

## 1. Home Page

-   Short introduction
-   Professional headshot or personal image
-   Career interests
-   Call-to-action buttons:

    -   Explore Projects
    -   Contact Me

## 2. About Me

-   Educational background
-   Professional goals
-   Personal brand statement
-   Strengths and values

## 3. Projects

-   Featured academic and team projects
-   Business analysis
-   Marketing strategy
-   International business/export planning
-   Data/statistics project work

## 4. Resume

-   Downloadable PDF resume
-   Experience
-   Leadership
-   Skills
-   Certifications

## 5. Contact Page

-   Email
-   LinkedIn
-   GitHub if applicable
-   Professional message form

## Home Page Concept

The home page should immediately communicate professionalism, clarity, and direction.

### Key content

-   Name and title\
    Example: **Allen Kian Cosme \| Business Student \| Strategy, Marketing, and Analytics**
-   One-sentence professional summary
-   Buttons for quick navigation
-   Clean hero image or strong visual banner
-   Minimal but polished layout

### Sample intro text

> I am a business student building experience in strategy, marketing, analytics, and global business through team-based research and applied projects.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## About Me Page

This page should tell a clear story about who I am and where I want to go.

### Content to include

-   Current school: **Cal Poly Pomona**
-   Major: **International Business**
-   Expected graduation: **December 2026**
-   Career interests:
    -   Marketing
    -   Business strategy
    -   Data-informed decision making
    -   International business
-   Short paragraph on goals and work style

### Suggested tone

-   Professional
-   Motivated
-   Reflective
-   Career-focused

::: notes
This page should sound more personal than the resume but still polished. Keep it concise and confident.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Resume Integration

This section should directly reflect my resume.

### Add these items from your resume

-   Professional summary
-   Education
-   Work experience
-   Leadership or extracurricular involvement
-   Skills
-   Awards or certifications

### Resume features on the site

-   Embedded PDF viewer
-   Download button
-   Short highlights beside the resume
-   Mobile-friendly formatting

## Featured Project Strategy

The project section will be the strongest part of the portfolio because it demonstrates applied business thinking.

### Project categories

-   Strategic management
-   Marketing planning
-   International business/export analysis
-   Equity research
-   Business statistics / analytics

### What each project card should show

-   Project title
-   Short summary
-   Tools or methods used
-   My role / contribution
-   Key takeaways
-   Link to report, slides, or visual summary
